condition: A — path identifiability under oracle structures

ffbs.child_seed_rule: SeedSequence(entropy=FFBS_MASTER_SEED, spawn_key=(global_trace_index,)) with global index 0..144 over train then heldout in frozen order
ffbs.mcse_rule: sd/sqrt(n) reported for every sample-based mean

label_alignment: NONE — fixed generating skill identities; no Hungarian or other alignment. Symmetry check: the three induced orders are pairwise distinct and pi/P entries are asymmetric, so no exact label symmetry exists; if one were found it would be reported, not silently aligned
map_rule: exact semi-Markov max-product; ties broken deterministically by first-encountered candidate (lowest start, then lowest skill index)
no_mcmc: exact semi-Markov forward-backward + Viterbi; FFBS iid draws only for nonlinear summaries; no burn-in, no thinning, no R-hat
stop_condition: no Condition B/C/D, no U/rho/scalar inference, no collapsed-U move, regardless of classification
target: p(S, z | x, U*, rho*, beta*, omega*, lambda_rep*, lambda_back*, pi*, P*, delta_B*, epsilon*) — per trace, conditionally independent; everything except (S, z) fixed to generating truth
threshold_note: 0.5 is fixed and never tuned on this corpus

strong_requires_all.path_evidence: MAP full labelled-path recovery >= 0.25 OR median true-path posterior >= 0.02
